definition: an instrument used in fighting or hunting
description: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

taps.phrase: to raise his hands in surrender
